Subject: Fellowship pilot credits and extended trial for HatchWorks cohort

Hi Karthik,

Great to meet you briefly at Startup Summit — HatchWorks runs a 10-team fellowship (cohort starts Apr 3) and we wanted to explore a pilot with Redwood for demo day builds. Two asks:

- Sponsorship: 150k token credit pool (approx) to support 3 months of development + demo workloads.
- Trial extension: extend the standard trial to 90 days for teams admitted to our fellowship.

I attached a short brief on the cohort and our fellowship criteria (HatchWorks_Fellowship_Brief.pdf). High level questions:
- Do you have an accelerator sponsorship template or T&Cs?
- Any eligibility requirements (company stage, runway, or existing credits) we should be aware of?

We can move quickly if there's a straightforward approval path. Looping in our procurement when we get to PO/Docs.

Thanks — would love a quick sync next week if helpful.

Best,

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and the brief, this looks promising. Quick answers up front:

- We can offer a cohort sponsorship structure. We typically scope a token allocation per cohort and tie milestone-based release for larger pools.
- Standard eligibility: pre-seed to Series A, company under 24 months is common but not strict — we focus on product fit and demo readiness.
- Yes, we have a sponsorship terms doc; attaching a draft (Sponsorship_Terms_v1.pdf).

Two quick clarifying items before I route for approval:
1) Do you want a single pooled credit (150k tokens) owned by HatchWorks, or per-team allocations that we can let individual teams claim?
2) Will the cohort teams need private deployment options / VPC connectivity for demo workloads, or is hosted acceptable?

Lauren and Monica — can you weigh in on the best approval path and any precedent for 150k pools? I can sync with Amy once we have a plan and get legal/finance signoff.

If helpful I can do a 25 minute call Monday to walk through the draft.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Quick internal note — precedent and recommended approach:

- For cohorts of this size we've done pooled allocations with per-team claim caps (e.g., pool 150k, up to 20k/team). It keeps onboarding friction low and prevents single-team drain.
- Milestone releases: we usually release 50% up front, 30% at mid-cohort demo, 20% for final demo artifacts.
- Trial extension: we can approve 90 days for fellowship participants if HatchWorks provides a short intake form and a single point of contact.

Approvals required: Program lead + Revenue Ops + Finance. I recommend:
- Program approval (Karthik)
- Submit Sponsorship_Terms_v1.pdf -> Legal quick review (we can request fast-track for partner pilots)
- Finance to note the promotional bucket and expiry window.

Monica — can you prepare a one-pager (MAP.xlsx) with milestone dates and the proposed per-team caps so we can attach to the approval? I can coordinate with Legal for quick review.

Lauren
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
